achievements.title: Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate
achievements.description: Completed an intensive, hands-on program focused on foundational security operations, risk management, and threat mitigation. Developed practical skills in vulnerability assessment, incident response, and network security using industry-standard tools including Python, SQL, Linux, and SIEM systems.

achievements.title: African Digital Conference (Digital Africa Rising 2026)
achievements.description: Represented Zambia on a continental stage as the Founder of the Youth Digital Empowerment Network during the 3-day regional summit, collaborating with leaders across 7 African nations to transform digital innovation into scalable impact.

achievements.title: Finalist: Best Media Promoter (Digital Media - Individual) – Tourism Excellence Awards
achievements.description: Honored by the Ministry of Tourism for excellence in digital storytelling, strategy, and media promotion. This recognition highlights strong personal brand leadership, creative execution, and a proven ability to leverage digital platforms to elevate national tourism initiatives.

achievements.title: Outstanding Speaker Distinction: National Capital Markets Debate Competition
achievements.description: Demonstrated exceptional public speaking, strategic policy analysis, and persuasive advocacy at the National Capital Markets Debate Competition hosted by the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). Recognized as the Overall Best Speaker at the Provincial Level, followed by commanding performances on the national stage to earn Overall Best Speaker honors in both the Quarter-Finals and the Grand Finals. Through rigorous arguments on economic governance, capital markets development, and investor protection, consistently delivered high-impact, evidence-based presentations that earned top ratings from judges across every competitive stage.
